# New grants aim to help small manufacturers afford cybersecurity compliance ## Xometry Foundation Announces Partnership with MxD to Expand Cybersecurity Access for Small and Mid-Sized Manufacturers \(Neutral\) \(Positive\) **Xometry \(NASDAQ: XMTR\)** announced that the Xometry Foundation has entered a new partnership with **MxD**, the nation’s Digital Manufacturing and Cybersecurity Institute, to help small and mid-sized manufacturers achieve cybersecurity compliance\. The initiative includes a grant program aimed at making compliance, including **CMMC Level 2**, more affordable and accessible\. According to Xometry, this partnership represents the next phase of the Xometry Foundation, which commits **$1 million per year** to developing the next generation of engineers and manufacturing talent\. The collaboration supports efforts to strengthen the U\.S\. aerospace and defense industrial base by helping smaller manufacturers protect operations, qualify for government contracts and support high-paying jobs in their communities\. # Xometry AI Routes Manufacturing Jobs to Better-Fit Suppliers ## Xometry Releases Comprehensive Upgrades to Its AI Model Architecture \(High\) \(Positive\) **Xometry \(NASDAQ: XMTR\)** announced comprehensive upgrades to its AI model architecture, deploying interconnected models across the manufacturing workflow that leverage proprietary data on geometry, manufacturability, pricing, supplier capability and production outcomes\. The enhanced, context-aware process recommender now suggests optimal manufacturing processes from 20 techniques on first upload, with buyers accepting AI recommendations more than **85%** of the time, according to Xometry\. New high-capacity cost models for CNC machining incorporate granular inputs such as geometry, material, finish and job composition, delivering an approximate **15% improvement** in CNC cost-prediction accuracy in live testing\. Adaptive sourcing models also dynamically price jobs and score supplier suitability using machine characteristics, quality history and on-time shipping records, which Xometry reports has significantly improved partner matching and created a more curated flow of jobs for supplier partners\.
